Alicia Smith (born 27 September 1996) is a professional Australian tennis player. She has career-high WTA rankings of 662 in singles, achieved on 10 August 2020, and 361 in doubles, achieved on 23 September 2024. Smith made her Grand Slam main-draw debut, after winning the 2016 Australian Open Women's Doubles Wildcard Playoff , granting her a wildcard into the 2017 Australian Open women's doubles event. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] In 2021, Smith won her debut ITF singles title at a $15k event in Solarino, Italy.
